description: ONLY on request; confirm the cost first. Creates the character's own voice from a description and an English reference script (write both with character_prompt kind 'voice'), plus any other languages listed in translations, each performed from the same description. Adults: ElevenLabs Voice Design, a saved voice and its reference take. Under 18: Qwen 3 Voice Design, deepened by pitch_semitones and cloned into a speaker embedding. Saves assets/voice/.

description.description: Who they are and how they sound: history, how they talk and to whom, then age, gender, timbre, pace, recording.

pitch_semitones.description: Minors only: deepen (negative) or lighten the designed voice. Default -2.

text.description: Reference script: their inner monologue in the moment the scene shows, thoughts to themselves, never addressed to the listener; natural voice, not a whisper. Eleven v3 tags like [sighs] are allowed; they are dropped for minors.

translations.description: Other languages to record in the same call, each performed fresh from the description (not a copy of the English take) → voice/reference.<lang>.mp3.

description.description: The voice description in that language, translated by meaning. Defaults to the English one.

text.description: The same monologue, written natively in that language for the same moment.

name: character_voice
title: Design the character's voice (on request, paid)
